name: Sebastián Guerra
headline: I build products from zero to launch.
subline: I turn complex ideas into products people use, and I make sure they ship.
description: Sebastián Guerra, Senior Product Manager. I build products from zero to launch: Kivval, Disney Parks, Qiddiya City and more.

howIWork.title: Align first
howIWork.text: Vision, roadmap and roles agreed before anything gets built.

howIWork.title: Listen to users
howIWork.text: Interviews, surveys and real data decide what comes next.

howIWork.title: Make tradeoffs explicit
howIWork.text: New scope in means something comes out. Said early, said clearly.

howIWork.title: Ship and measure
howIWork.text: Predictable releases, and numbers that show what changed.

beforeSoftware.title: Discovery started on building facades
beforeSoftware.text: At ES Metals (Tecnoglass), 2019–2021, I created the R&D area and searched for new products, materials and suppliers for facade projects in the US.

items.title: 135 East · Manhattan
items.text: Found the thermal insulation for a metal facade that holds from summer to winter, and stands up to wind and corrosion.

items.alt: Doral Square mall facade in Miami
items.title: Doral Square · Miami
items.text: Mall facade delivered with materials sourced through R&D discovery.

items.title: Weymouth · Boston
items.text: Facade delivered with materials sourced through R&D discovery.

beforeSoftware.footnote: Before that, I led an industrial design team in Melbourne and cut change-order time from 45 to 15 minutes with Lean.

contact.title: Building something that needs to ship?
contact.text: 9 years across product and delivery in the Americas, the Middle East and Australia. Open to strategic product roles.

design.eyebrow: Product Design Engineer · Colombia and Australia · 2016–2019
design.title: Design and 3D work
design.intro: Before product management, I designed spaces and visualized them for clients. In every image here I designed the space, modeled it in Rhinoceros and rendered it in V-Ray.

process.title: 1 · Understand
process.text: Research the need and the problem behind it.

process.title: 2 · Co-create
process.text: Ideate with the client until the concept feels right.

process.title: 3 · Detail
process.text: 3D model, renders, technical drawings and production.
